items.translation: Jackson 模块，用于根据传入实例的 SpringDataWebSettings 自定义 PageImpl 的序列化行为。

items.translation: 由能够管理多个EntityCallback对象并针对特定实体调用这些对象的接口。

items.translation: 审计处理器，用于标记已创建和修改的实体对象。

items.translation: 提供使用分页和排序抽象检索实体的方法的存储库片段。

items.translation: 拦截器，用于强制实施在仓储查询方法上声明的返回值和方法参数约束。

items.translation: Spring Data 的 QueryDSL 专用 Web 配置。

items.source: AuditingHandler extension that uses PersistentEntity.isNew(Object) to expose a generic IsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object) method that will route calls to AuditingHandler.markCreated(Object) or AuditingHandler.markModified(Object) based on the IsNewStrategy determined from the factory.
items.translation: 扩展了AuditingHandler，它使用PersistentEntity.isNew(Object)来暴露一个通用的 IsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object)方法。该方法将根据工厂确定的IsNewStrategy，将调用路由到 AuditingHandler.markCreated(Object)或 AuditingHandler.markModified(Object)。

items.source: AuditingHandler extension that uses PersistentEntity.isNew(Object) to expose a generic ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object) method that will route calls to ReactiveAuditingHandler.markCreated(Object) or ReactiveAuditingHandler.markModified(Object) based on the IsNewStrategy determined from the factory.
items.translation: 扩展了AuditingHandler，利用PersistentEntity.isNew(Object)来暴露一个通用的 ReactiveIsNewAwareAuditingHandler.markAudited(Object)方法。该方法将根据工厂确定的IsNewStrategy，将调用路由到 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markCreated(Object)或 ReactiveAuditingHandler.markModified(Object)。

items.source: RepositoryProxyPostProcessor to register a MethodInterceptor to intercept CrudRepository.save(Object) and CrudRepository.delete(Object) methods and publish events potentially exposed via a method annotated with DomainEvents.
items.translation: 使用RepositoryProxyPostProcessor注册一个MethodInterceptor，以拦截CrudRepository.save(Object)和CrudRepository.delete(Object)方法，并发布可能通过带有DomainEvents注解的方法暴露的事件。

items.source: A RevisionMetadata implementation that inspects the given object for fields with the configured annotations and returns the field's values on calls to AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionInstant(), AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionInstant() and AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionNumber().
items.translation: 一个 RevisionMetadata 实现，它会检查给定对象上带有配置注解的字段，并在调用 AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionInstant()、AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionInstant() 和 AnnotationRevisionMetadata.getRevisionNumber() 时返回这些字段的值。

items.source: PersistentPropertyAccessor that potentially converts the value handed to ConvertingPropertyAccessor.setProperty(PersistentProperty, Object) to the type of the PersistentProperty using a ConversionService.
items.translation: PersistentPropertyAccessor 可能会将传递给 ConvertingPropertyAccessor.setProperty(PersistentProperty, Object) 的值转换为 PersistentProperty 的类型，该转换通过一个 ConversionService 完成。

items.source: Combined EntityReader and EntityWriter and add the ability to access a MappingContext and ConversionService.
items.translation: 合并了 EntityReader 和 EntityWriter，并增加了对 MappingContext 和 ConversionService 的访问能力。

items.source: JavaConfig class to register PagedResourcesAssembler, PagedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver, SlicedResourcesAssembler and SlicedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver.
items.translation: JavaConfig 类用于注册 PagedResourcesAssembler、PagedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver、SlicedResourcesAssembler 和 SlicedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver。

items.source: BeanDefinitionParser to create BeanDefinitions of NamedQueries instances looking up a Properties file fom the given location.
items.translation: 使用 BeanDefinitionParser 来创建 BeanDefinition，这些定义对应于从指定位置查找 NamedQueries 实例的 Properties 文件。

items.source: ParameterValueProvider based on a PersistentEntity to use a PropertyValueProvider to lookup the value of the property referenced by the given Parameter.
items.translation: 基于PersistentEntity的ParameterValueProvider，用于通过给定的Parameter查找由PropertyValueProvider引用的属性值。

items.source: A reactive EvaluationContextProvider that assembles an EvaluationContext from a list of ReactiveEvaluationContextExtension and EvaluationContextExtension instances.
items.translation: 一个反应式的EvaluationContextProvider，它从一组ReactiveEvaluationContextExtension和EvaluationContextExtension实例中组装一个EvaluationContext。

items.source: ApplicationEvent being thrown after a RepositoryPopulator has finished populating the Repositories available in the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在 ApplicationEvent 被抛出之前，RepositoryPopulator 已完成对 Repositories 的填充工作，而该 ApplicationContext 中包含了这些可用的仓库。

items.source: Functional interface to obtain RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments for a given BeanFactory (can be null), EntityInformation and ValueExpressionDelegate.
items.translation: 用于获取给定RepositoryComposition.RepositoryFragments的功能接口，该给定对象包括一个可能为 null 的BeanFactory、一个EntityInformation以及一个ValueExpressionDelegate。

items.source: Configuration class to register PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver, SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver, OffsetScrollPositionHandlerMethodArgumentResolver and DomainClassConverter.
items.translation: 用于注册 PageableHandlerMethodArgumentResolver、SortHandlerMethodArgumentResolver、OffsetScrollPositionHandlerMethodArgumentResolver 以及 DomainClassConverter 的配置类。

items.source: An Iterator over multiple Windows obtained via a window function, that keeps track of the current ScrollPosition allowing scrolling across all result elements.
items.translation: 一个通过window function获取的多个Windows上的Iterator，它跟踪当前的ScrollPosition，从而允许在所有结果元素之间滚动。

items.translation: BeanDefinitionParser 用于解析一个 AuditingHandler 的 BeanDefinition

items.translation: 一个 EvaluationContextProvider，它从一组 EvaluationContextExtension 实例中组装出一个 EvaluationContext。

items.source: Custom Page to carry the average distance retrieved from the GeoResults the GeoPage is set up from.
items.translation: 自定义Page以承载从GeoResults检索到的平均距离，GeoPage正是基于此构建的。

items.source: A PersistentPropertyAccessor that will use an entity's PersistenceCreator to create a new instance of it to apply a new value for a given PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 一个PersistentPropertyAccessor，它将使用实体上的PersistenceCreator注解来创建该实体的新实例，以便为给定的PersistentProperty应用新值。

items.source: Delegating PersistentPropertyAccessorFactory decorating the PersistentPropertyAccessors created with an InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor to allow the handling of purely immutable types.
items.translation: 委托一个装饰由PersistentPropertyAccessor创建的InstantiationAwarePropertyAccessor的PersistentPropertyAccessorFactory，以支持处理纯不可变类型。

items.source: FactoryBean to set up a ResourceReaderRepositoryPopulator with a JacksonResourceReader.
items.translation: 使用FactoryBean来配置一个带有JacksonResourceReader的ResourceReaderRepositoryPopulator。

items.source: BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor implementation used to encapsulate common data infrastructure concerns and preprocess the ConfigurableListableBeanFactory ahead of the AOT compilation in order to prepare the Spring Data BeanDefinitions for AOT processing.
items.translation: 用于封装通用数据基础设施关注点并提前对 ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 进行预处理，以便为 AOT 编译准备 Spring Data BeanDefinitions 的 BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor 实现。

items.source: AuditableBeanWrapperFactory that will create am AuditableBeanWrapper using mapping information obtained from a MappingContext to detect auditing configuration and eventually invoking setting the auditing values.
items.translation: 一个用于创建 `AuditableBeanWrapper` 的 `AuditableBeanWrapperFactory`，它利用从 `MappingContext` 获取的映射信息来检测审计配置，并最终调用设置审计值的方法。

items.source: Argument resolver to extract a OffsetScrollPosition object from a NativeWebRequest for a particular MethodParameter.
items.translation: 用于从特定MethodParameter的NativeWebRequest中提取OffsetScrollPosition对象的参数解析器。

items.source: Argument resolver to extract a Pageable object from a NativeWebRequest for a particular MethodParameter.
items.translation: 用于从特定MethodParameter的NativeWebRequest中提取Pageable对象的参数解析器。

items.source: RepresentationModelAssembler to easily convert Page instances into PagedModel.
items.translation: RepresentationModelAssembler 可轻松将 Page 实例转换为 PagedModel。

items.source: Class to parse a String into a tree or PartTree.OrParts consisting of simple Part instances in turn.
items.translation: 用于解析 `String` 为树或 PartTree.OrPart 的类，后者由简单的 Part 实例组成。

items.source: EntityInformation implementation that uses a PersistentEntity to obtain id type information and uses a IdentifierAccessor to access the property value if requested.
items.translation: 一个实现了EntityInformation接口的类，它使用PersistentEntity来获取 ID 类型信息，并在需要时使用IdentifierAccessor来访问属性值。

items.source: Configuration class to register a BeanPostProcessor to augment RequestMappingHandlerAdapter with a ProxyingHandlerMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 用于注册 BeanPostProcessor 的配置类，该处理器用于增强 RequestMappingHandlerAdapter，并添加一个 ProxyingHandlerMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: PropertyValueConversions provides access to converters that may only be applied to a specific property.
items.translation: PropertyValueConversions 提供了对 converters 的访问权限，这些转换器仅可应用于特定的 property。

items.source: Configuration class used to register a PropertyValueConverter with a SimplePropertyValueConverterRegistry that can be used in PropertyValueConversions.
items.translation: 用于向可应用于PropertyValueConversions的SimplePropertyValueConverterRegistry注册一个PropertyValueConverter的配置类。

items.source: RepositoryInvoker that is aware of a QuerydslPredicateExecutor and Predicate to be executed for all flavors of findAll(…).
items.translation: RepositoryInvoker，它感知到需要执行的 QuerydslPredicateExecutor 和 Predicate，适用于所有类型的 findAll(…) 方法。

items.source: SPI to resolve a EvaluationContextExtension to make it accessible via the root of an EvaluationContext provided by a ReactiveExtensionAwareEvaluationContextProvider.
items.translation: SPI 用于解析 EvaluationContextExtension，以便通过由 ReactiveExtensionAwareEvaluationContextProvider 提供的 EvaluationContext 的根节点来访问它。

items.source: Reactive HandlerMethodArgumentResolver to create Sort instances from query string parameters or SortDefault annotations.
items.translation: 将 HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 作为响应式组件，用于从查询字符串参数或 SortDefault 注解中创建 Sort 实例。

items.source: Interface for components that can provide meta-information about a repository factory, the backing EntityInformation and RepositoryInformation as well as the QueryMethods exposed by the repository.
items.translation: 提供有关仓库工厂、底层EntityInformation和RepositoryInformation以及仓库所暴露的QueryMethod元信息的组件接口。

items.source: A RepositoryPopulator using a ResourceReader to read objects from the configured Resources.
items.translation: 一个使用 ResourceReader 从配置的 Resource 中读取对象的 RepositoryPopulator。

items.source: PropertyValueConversions implementation allowing a PropertyValueConverterFactory creating converters to be chosen.
items.translation: 实现 PropertyValueConversions 接口，允许通过 PropertyValueConverterFactory 创建转换器，以便从中选择所需的 converters。

items.source: RepresentationModelAssembler to easily convert Slice instances into SlicedModel.
items.translation: RepresentationModelAssembler 可轻松将 Slice 实例转换为 SlicedModel。

items.source: Argument resolver to extract a Sort object from a NativeWebRequest for a particular MethodParameter.
items.translation: 用于从特定MethodParameter的NativeWebRequest中提取Sort对象的参数解析器。

items.source: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver to automatically create Sort instances from request parameters or SortDefault annotations.
items.translation: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 可自动从请求参数或 SortDefault 注解创建 Sort 实例。

items.source: Parser to populate the given ClassPathScanningCandidateComponentProvider with TypeFilters parsed from the given Element's children.
items.translation: 解析器，用于将给定 ClassPathScanningCandidateComponentProvider 填充由给定 Element 的子元素解析出的 TypeFilters。

items.source: FactoryBean to create a ResourceReaderRepositoryPopulator using an Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 使用 FactoryBean 创建一个 ResourceReaderRepositoryPopulator，该创建过程使用一个 Unmarshaller。

items.source: An extension of ValueExpressionQueryRewriter that can create ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.QueryExpressionEvaluator instances as it also knows about a QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor.

items.source: XmlAdapter to convert Sort instances into SpringDataJaxb.SortDto instances and vice versa.

items.source: Convenience base class for aggregate roots that exposes a AbstractAggregateRoot.registerEvent(Object) to capture domain events and expose them via AbstractAggregateRoot.domainEvents().
items.translation: 这是一个用于聚合根的便捷基类，它提供了 `AbstractAggregateRoot.registerEvent(Object)` 方法以捕获领域事件，并通过 `AbstractAggregateRoot.domainEvents()` 暴露这些事件。

items.source: Base class to build mapping metadata and thus create instances of PersistentEntity and PersistentProperty.

items.translation: 创建ResourceReaderRepositoryPopulator的FactoryBean的基础类。

items.translation: 支持类，用于委托给底层AotContext的AotRepositoryContext实现。

items.translation: FieldNamingStrategy 通过取 PersistentProperty 名称中驼峰式各部分的首字母来缩写字段名称。

items.source: A CloseableIterator serves as a bridging data structure for the underlying data store specific results that can be wrapped in a Java 8 java.util.stream.Stream.
items.translation: `CloseableIterator` 作为一种桥接数据结构，用于封装底层数据存储返回的特定结果，使其能够被包装为 Java 8 的 `java.util.stream.Stream`。

items.translation: 默认情况下，DateTimeProvider 会为每次方法调用创建新的 LocalDateTime 实例。

items.source: Value object holding the actual CustomConversions.StoreConversions and custom converters configured for registration.

items.translation: Value 类将 CustomConversions.ConverterRegistration 及其 origin 绑定在一起，以支持基于存储支持的类型进行细粒度注册。

items.source: Default implementation of RepositoryInvokerFactory to inspect the requested repository type and create a matching RepositoryInvoker that suits the repository best.

items.source: Useful base class to implement custom EntityInformations and delegate execution of standard methods from EntityInformation to a special implementation.
items.translation: 这是一个有用的基类，用于实现自定义的 EntityInformation，并将 EntityInformation 的标准方法执行委托给特殊实现。

items.source: Converter to create Distance instances from String representations.
items.translation: Converter 用于从 String 表示形式创建 Distance 实例。

items.source: Converter to convert arbitrary input into domain classes managed by Spring Data CrudRepositorys.
items.translation: Converter 用于将任意输入转换为由 Spring Data CrudRepository 管理的领域类。

items.translation: 注册一个用于承载 SpringDataWebSettings 配置值的 Bean 定义，该配置值对应于 EnableSpringDataWebSupport 注解接口。

items.source: Descriptor for a property-level type along its potential projection that is held within a Collection-like or Map-like container.

items.source: HandlerMethodArgumentResolver to allow injection of PagedResourcesAssembler into Spring MVC controller methods.

items.source: Types managed by a Spring Data implementation.
items.translation: 由 Spring Data 实现管理的类型。

items.source:
This interface defines the overall context including all known PersistentEntity instances and methods to obtain
instances on demand. it is used internally to establish associations between entities and also at runtime to obtain
entities by name.
items.translation: 该接口定义了整体上下文，包括所有已知的持久实体（PersistentEntity）实例以及按需获取这些实例的方法。它在内部用于建立实体之间的关联，并在运行时通过名称获取实体。

items.source: Exception being thrown in case an entity could not be instantiated in the process of a to-object-mapping.
items.translation: 在对象映射过程中，如果无法实例化实体，则抛出异常。

items.source: Strategy for contributing AOT repository methods by looking introspecting query methods.
items.translation: 通过内省查询方法贡献 AOT 存储库方法的策略。

items.source: Builder for a query method contributor.
items.translation: 查询方法贡献者的构建器。

items.source: Initial builder for a query method contributor.
items.translation: 查询方法贡献者的初始构建器。

items.source: Customizer for a contributed AOT repository query method.
items.translation: 为贡献的 AOT 存储库查询方法提供的自定义器。

items.source:
Value object that encapsulates introspection of a method's return type, providing convenient access to its
characteristics such as projection, optionality, array status, and actual type information.
items.translation: 封装方法返回类型内省操作的值对象，提供对其特性的便捷访问，包括投影、可选性、数组状态以及实际类型信息。

items.source:
Annotation to exclude repository interfaces from being picked up and thus in consequence getting an instance being
created.
items.translation: 用于排除仓库接口被拾取，从而避免为其创建实例的注解。

items.source: Simple value object to wrap a nullable delegate.
items.translation: 一个简单的值对象，用于封装可空委托。

items.source: Converters to wrap and unwrap nullable wrapper types potentially being available on the classpath.
items.translation: 可能存在于类路径上，用于包装和解包装可空包装类型的转换器。

items.source: A page is a sublist of a list of objects.
items.translation: 页面是对象列表的子列表。

items.source: Abstract interface for pagination information.
items.translation: 分页信息的抽象接口。

items.source: A tuple of things.
items.translation: 事物的元组。

items.source: Annotation to bind method parameters to a query via a named parameter.
items.translation: 用于通过命名参数将方法参数绑定到查询的注解。

items.source: Value object to represent constructor parameters.
items.translation: 表示构造函数参数的值对象。

items.source: Class to abstract a single parameter of a query method.
items.translation: 用于抽象查询方法单个参数的类。

items.source: Interface to access method parameters.
items.translation: 用于访问方法参数的接口。

items.source: Abstracts method parameters that have to be bound to query parameters or applied to the query independently.
items.translation: 摘要方法参数，这些参数需要绑定到查询参数或独立应用于查询。

items.source:
Interface providing access to the method, containing class and domain type as source object for parameter
descriptors.
items.translation: 提供对方法的访问，并将包含类及域类型作为参数描述符的源对象。

items.source: A single part of a method name that has to be transformed into a query part.
items.translation: 方法名中必须转换为查询部分的一个组成部分。

items.source: The various types of ignore case that are supported.
items.translation: 支持的多种忽略大小写类型。

items.source: The type of method name part.
items.translation: 方法名部分的类型。

items.source: A part of the parsed source that results from splitting up the resource around Or keywords.
items.translation: 由围绕 Or 关键字拆分资源所得到的解析源的一部分。

items.source: Simple interface for entities.
items.translation: 实体的简单接口。

items.source: Marker annotation to declare a constructor or factory method annotation as factory/preferred constructor annotation.
items.translation: 使用标记注解来声明构造函数或工厂方法注解为工厂/首选构造函数注解。

items.source: Annotation to generally identify persistent types, fields and parameters.
items.translation: 用于一般性地标识持久化类型、字段和参数的注解。

items.source: Represents a persistent entity.
items.translation: 表示持久实体。

items.source: Represents a geospatial point value.
items.translation: 表示地理空间点值。

items.source: Value object to encapsulate the constructor to be used when mapping persistent data to objects.
items.translation: 用于封装在将持久化数据映射到对象时应使用的构造函数的值对象。

items.source:
Annotation to mark projection interfaces and handler method projection arguments that are supposed to be used as
projection interface to bind request or response payloads to.
items.translation: 用于标记投影接口和处理器方法中的投影参数，这些参数将作为投影接口，用于绑定请求或响应负载。

items.source:
A factory to create projecting instances for other objects usually used to allow easy creation of representation
projections to define which properties of a domain objects shall be exported in which way.
items.translation: 工厂用于为其他对象创建投影实例，通常用于方便地定义表示投影，以指定域对象的哪些属性应以何种方式导出。

items.source: Information about a projection type.
items.translation: 投影类型的信息。

items.source: Interface providing type-safe property references.
items.translation: 提供类型安全的属性引用的接口。

items.source: Exception indicating errors during property reference or property path resolution.
items.translation: 表示在属性引用或属性路径解析期间发生错误的异常。

items.source: Helper class used to build a fluent API to register how to read a database value into a domain object property.
items.translation: 辅助类，用于构建流式 API 以注册如何将数据库值读取到领域对象属性中。

items.source: Helper class used to build up a fluent registration API starting with writing.
items.translation: 用于构建以写入为起点的流式注册 API 的辅助类。

items.source: SPI to extend Spring's default proxy detection capabilities.
items.translation: SPI 将扩展 Spring 默认的代理检测功能。

items.source: Meta-Annotation to mark a store specific annotation as a query annotation.
items.translation: 元标注：用于将特定于商店的标注标记为查询标注。

items.source: Utility class for Querydsl.
items.translation: Querydsl 工具类。

items.source:
Converters to potentially wrap the execution of a repository method into a variety of wrapper types potentially being
available on the classpath.
items.translation: 转换器可将仓库方法的执行封装为多种包装类型，这些类型可能存在于类路径中。

items.source: Enumeration of available query lookup strategies.
items.translation: 可用查询查找策略的枚举。

items.source: Interface providing metadata about a query.
items.translation: 提供查询元数据的接口。

items.source: Abstraction of a method that is designated to execute a finder query.
items.translation: 抽象一个用于执行查找查询的方法。

items.source: Exception to represent a failed attempt to convert a source value into a query method parameter.
items.translation: 异常，用于表示将源值转换为查询方法参数时尝试失败。

items.source: Simple value object to work with ranges and boundaries.
items.translation: 用于处理范围和边界的简单值对象。

items.source: Value object representing a boundary.
items.translation: 表示边界的值对象。

items.source: Base class for repository factories to use reactive support.
items.translation: 用于支持响应式编程的仓储工厂基类。

items.source: Conversion support for reactive wrapper types.
items.translation: 支持反应式包装类型的转换。

items.source: Utility class to expose details about reactive wrapper types.
items.translation: 用于暴露反应式包装类型详情的工具类。

items.source: Enumeration of supported reactive libraries.
items.translation: 支持的响应式库枚举。

items.source: Marks a field to be read-only for the mapping framework and therefore will not be persisted.
items.translation: 将字段标记为映射框架中的只读，因此该字段不会被持久化。

items.source: Meta-annotation to be used to annotate annotations that mark references to other objects.
items.translation: 用于标注标记对其他对象引用的元注释。

items.source: Spring Data specific reflection utility methods and classes.
items.translation: Spring Data 专用的反射工具方法和类。

items.source: Central repository marker interface.
items.translation: 中央存储库标记接口。

items.source: Base class to implement repository namespaces.
items.translation: 实现仓库命名空间的基类。

items.source: Composite implementation to back repository method implementations.
items.translation: 用于回退存储库方法实现的组合实现。

items.source: Configuration information for a single repository instance.
items.translation: 单个仓库实例的配置信息。

items.source: Delegate for configuration integration to reuse the general way of detecting repositories.
items.translation: 配置集成的委托，用于复用检测仓库的通用方式。

items.source: SPI to implement store specific extension to the repository bean definition registration process.
items.translation: SPI 将实现针对存储库 Bean 定义注册过程的特定扩展。

items.source: Interface containing the configurable options for the Spring Data repository subsystem.
items.translation: 包含 Spring Data 仓库子系统可配置选项的接口。

items.source: Contributor for AOT repository fragments.
items.translation: AOT 存储库片段的贡献者。

items.source: Exception thrown in the context of repository creation.
items.translation: 在创建存储库的上下文中抛出异常。

items.source: Annotation to demarcate interfaces a repository proxy shall be created for.
items.translation: 用于界定仓库代理应为其创建的接口的注释。

items.source: Creation context for a Repository Fragment.
items.translation: 仓库碎片创建上下文。

items.source: Factory bean to create instances of a given repository interface.
items.translation: 用于创建给定仓库接口实例的工厂 Bean。

items.source: Value object representing a repository fragment.
items.translation: 表示存储库片段的值对象。

items.source: Fragment configuration consisting of an interface name and the implementation class name.
items.translation: 由接口名称和实现类名称组成的片段配置。

items.source: Additional repository specific information
items.translation: 其他仓库特定信息

items.source: Meta-information about the methods a repository exposes.
items.translation: 关于仓库所公开方法的元信息。

items.source: API to invoke (CRUD) methods on Spring Data repository instances independently of the base interface they expose.
items.translation: 独立于其暴露的基础接口，用于调用 Spring Data 存储库实例的 CRUD 方法的 API。

items.source: Metadata for repository interfaces.
items.translation: 存储库接口的元数据。

items.source: Marker for repository fragment implementation that intend to access repository method invocation metadata.
items.translation: 用于标记旨在访问仓库方法调用元数据的仓库片段实现的注解。

items.source: Interface containing methods and value objects to obtain information about the current repository method invocation.
items.translation: 包含用于获取当前仓库方法调用信息的接口、方法和值对象的集合。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by listeners that want to be notified upon repository method invocation.
items.translation: 由希望在被调用仓库方法时收到通知的监听器所实现的接口。

items.source: Value object capturing the actual invocation.
items.translation: 捕获实际调用的值对象。

items.source: Interface for components that will populate the Spring Data repositories with objects.
items.translation: 用于向 Spring Data 仓库填充对象的组件接口。

items.source: Callback interface used during repository proxy creation.
items.translation: 在仓库代理创建期间使用的回调接口。

items.source: Interface for a query abstraction.
items.translation: 查询抽象接口。

items.source: Information about a revision entity which is the class carrying revision information for an entity.
items.translation: 包含实体修订信息的类的修订实体信息。

items.source: Metadata about a revision.
items.translation: 修订元数据。

items.source: Strategy interface for scoring functions.
items.translation: 评分函数的策略接口。

items.source: Interface to specify a position within a total query result.
items.translation: 用于指定总查询结果中位置的接口。

items.source: Keyset scrolling direction.
items.translation: 键集滚动方向。

items.source: Common interface for all shapes.
items.translation: 所有形状的通用接口。

items.source: Simple container to hold a set of types to be considered simple types.
items.translation: 一个简单的容器，用于存放一组将被视为简单类型的类型。

items.source: A slice of data that indicates whether there's a next or previous slice available.
items.translation: 指示是否存在下一个或上一个数据块的切片。

items.source: Sort option for queries.
items.translation: 查询的排序选项。

items.source: Enumeration for sort directions.
items.translation: 排序方向的枚举。

items.source: JavaConfig class to export Jackson 3-specific configuration.
items.translation: 用于导出 Jackson 3 特定配置的 JavaConfig 类。

items.source: Marks a field to be transient for the mapping framework.
items.translation: 标记该字段为映射框架的瞬态字段。

items.source: Simple constants holder.
items.translation: 简单常量持有器。

items.source: Interface to abstract implementations of how to access a type alias from a given source or sink.
items.translation: 用于抽象如何从给定源或汇访问类型别名的接口。

items.source: Collector to inspect domain types and discover the type graph that is relevant for Spring Data operations.
items.translation: 收集器用于检查域类型并发现与 Spring Data 操作相关的类型图。

items.source: Container for reachable types starting from a set of root types.
items.translation: 从一组根类型开始可达类型的容器。

items.source:
Strategy interface providing predicates to filter types, fields, and methods from being introspected and
contributed to AOT processing.
items.translation: 提供谓词以过滤类型、字段和方法，防止其被内省并贡献给 AOT 处理的策略接口。

items.source: Interface providing type-safe property path navigation through method references expressions.
items.translation: 提供通过方法引用表达式实现类型安全的属性路径导航的接口。

items.source: Interface to access property types and resolving generics on the way.
items.translation: 用于访问属性类型并在过程中解析泛型的接口。

items.source: Interface to abstract the mapping from a type alias to the actual type.
items.translation: 用于抽象从类型别名到实际类型的映射的接口。

items.source: Interface to define strategies how to store type information in a store specific sink or source.
items.translation: 定义如何在特定存储库的汇或源中存储类型信息的接口。

items.source: A scanner that searches the classpath for matching types within given target packages.
items.translation: 一个在给定目标包中搜索匹配类型的类路径扫描器。

items.source:
Exception thrown during repository creation when a well-known fragment interface is not supported by the repository
factory.
items.translation: 在仓库工厂创建仓库时，若不支持知名的片段接口，则抛出异常。

items.source: Expressions are executed using an evaluation context.
items.translation: 表达式使用求值上下文执行。

items.source: An expression capable of evaluating itself against context objects.
items.translation: 一种能够根据上下文对象进行自我评估的表达式。

items.source: SPI for components that can evaluate Value expressions.
items.translation: 支持评估 Value 表达式的组件的 SPI。

items.source: Parses expression strings into expressions that can be evaluated.
items.translation: 将表达式字符串解析为可求值的表达式。

items.source:
A ValueExpressionQueryRewriter is able to detect Value expressions in a query string and to replace them
with bind variables.
items.translation: ValueExpressionQueryRewriter 能够检测查询字符串中的 Value 表达式，并将其替换为绑定变量。

items.source: A vector is a fixed-length array of non-null numeric values.
items.translation: 向量是一个由非空数值组成的定长数组。

items.source: Demarcates a property to be used as version field to implement optimistic locking on entities.
items.translation: 指定用于在实体上实现乐观锁的版本字段。

items.source: Value object to represent a Version consisting of major, minor and bugfix part.
items.translation: 表示由主版本号、次版本号和修正号组成的版本的值对象。

items.source: A set of data consumed from an underlying query result.
items.translation: 从底层查询结果中消费的一组数据。
